div.head: III Atr Prol.
div.ab: Hę sunt leges, quas Æþelredus rex et sapientes sui constituerunt apud Wanetingum ad emendationem pacis et felicitatis incrementum.
Ðis syndon þa lága, þe Æðelred cyng ⁊ his witan gerædd habbað æt Wánetinge to friðes bóte.
Ðis syndon þa lága þe Æðelred cyng ⁊ his witan gerædd habbað æt Wánetingc to friðes bóte.
These are the constitutions which King Æthelred and his councillors have enacted at Wantage for the promotion of public security.
These are the laws which King Ethelred and his councillors have decreed at Wantage, for the improvement of public security.
Prolog. Dies sind die Gesetze, welche König Aethelred und seine Witan beschlossen haben zu Wantage, zur Besserung öffentlicher Sicherheit.
Prologue. These are the laws which King Æthelred and his witan have decided at Wantage, for the improvement of public security.
div.note: The Latin is the Quadripartitus (after I Atr in the Quadr. MSS). Liebermann's Old English base text H (Textus Roffensis f. 48, after ‘Willelmes asetnysse’, c. 1125). Dated 981–1012 (997?). ‘æfter Dena lage’ may have followed in the original (Liebermann; compare I Atr Prol.). Quadr.'s ‘et felicitatis incrementum’ is its own addition.
